ModMetaData.name: RimMind - Storyteller
ModMetaData.author: mcocdaa
ModMetaData.description:
[h1]RimMind - Storyteller (v2.0)[/h1] AI Story Director, dramatic tension curve engine, and causal narrative incident selector for RimWorld. Instead of rolling arbitrary raid dice based solely on wealth graphs, the AI Storyteller observes your colony's real history, emotional pacing, and unresolved conflicts to orchestrate multi-chapter sagas, bespoke lore letters, and interactive Storyteller Altar dialogues.
[b]v2.0 Clean Architecture & RimWorld 1.6 / 1.7 Dual-Version Support:[/b] [list] [*][b]RimWorld 1.6 & 1.7 (Waylith / .NET 10) Ready[/b]: Native multi-target compilation supporting both RimWorld 1.6 (.NET Framework 4.8) and RimWorld 1.7 (.NET 10 / Harmony 2.x & 3.x). [*][b]v2.0 Resilient Director Pipeline[/b]: Non-blocking request lifecycle coordination ([code]StorytellerRequestCoordinator[/code]) with 15,000-tick timeout protection, 2,500-tick failure backoff, and automatic truncated JSON repair. Note: v1.x saves are not compatible with v2.0. [*][b]Full Vanilla Trader / Caravan / Quest Ecosystem Preserved[/b]: Combines AI narrative direction with vanilla RimWorld's complete orbital trader, faction caravan, visitor, and quest generation schedule so your colony economy and diplomacy thrive naturally. [/list]
[h2]What Is RimMind[/h2] RimMind is an enterprise-grade, AI-powered RimWorld mod suite. Integrated with Large Language Models (LLM), it transforms colonists into self-reflecting agents with distinct personalities, three-tier memories, natural spoken dialogues, autonomous mechanisms, and dynamic storytelling.

[h2]Core Features[/h2] [list] [*][b]AI Event Selection & Causal Lore Letters[/b] - Evaluates valid in-game [code]IncidentDef[/code] candidates ([code]CanFireNow[/code]) against your colony's recent history from [code]RimMind-Memory[/code], crafting custom incident letters that directly reference your colonists' past deeds. [*][b]Dramatic Tension Curve ([code]StorytellerMemory[/code] & [code]TensionMath[/code])[/b] - Continuously tracks colony hardship, casualties, mood equilibrium, and daily tension decay to balance intense climaxes with earned recovery periods. [*][b]Multi-Chapter Narrative Event Chains[/b] - Links incidents across multi-step story arcs ([code]chain_id[/code], [code]chain_step[/code], [code]chain_total[/code], [code]next_hint[/code]) with bounded threat-point multipliers and faction/raid strategy hints. [*][b]Storyteller Altar & Agent Console[/b] - Build the in-game [b]Storyteller Altar[/b] to converse directly with the AI Story Director ([code]Window_StorytellerDialogue[/code]), negotiate your colony's fate, or inspect/steer narrative pacing via [code]Window_StorytellerAgentControl[/code]. [*][b]Full Vanilla Trader / Caravan / Quest Ecosystem[/b] - Retains full vanilla storyteller [code]StorytellerComp[/code] schedules for orbital traders, allied trade caravans, hospitality visitors, and quests alongside AI-directed dramatic arcs. [*][b]Intelligent Fallback Mode[/b] - If your LLM API is offline, rate-limited, or unconfigured, seamlessly falls back to balanced tension-aware incident selection so gameplay never stalls. [/list]

Candidate Filtering[/td][td]RimMindIncidentSelector[/td][td]Pre-filters valid IncidentDefs via CanFireNow and groups threats, blessings, and neutral events[/td][/tr] [tr][td]3. Parse & Fire[/td][td]StorytellerResponseParserPure[/td][td]Validates incident choice, clamps threat points, fires custom letter & records chain step[/td][/tr] [/table]
[h2]Frequently Asked Questions[/h2] [b]Q: Will I still get regular trade caravans, orbital traders, and quests?[/b] A: Yes! The AI Storyteller preserves the full vanilla trader, caravan, and quest generation ecosystem while directing narrative events and story chains on top.
[b]Q: What happens if an AI request times out or my API key runs out?[/b] A: [code]StorytellerRequestCoordinator[/code] automatically recovers from timeouts after 15,000 ticks and uses tension-balanced fallback selection so your campaign continues smoothly.
